subtitle: A Wikipedia-sourced attention snapshot for Apple originals while a recurring weekly chart source is unavailable.

cityPreview.summary: Apple originals ranked by Wikipedia attention as a temporary source-backed bootstrap, not an official weekly Top 10.

sourceStatus: Wikipedia pageview bootstrap for Apple TV+ originals
confidence: Observed 30 days of en.wikipedia pageviews for titles listed on 2 Wikipedia platform-original page(s) at 2026-09-01T07:03:08.053Z. This is not a weekly or current streaming Top 10.
methodology: Wikipedia does not currently provide a durable weekly/current Top 10 page for Apple TV+. This bootstrap uses the configured Wikipedia original-programming and original-film list pages as the source universe, then ranks titles by recent en.wikipedia pageviews via Wikipedia's PageViewInfo API. Treat the output as public-interest attention among platform originals, not streaming watch time or official platform ranking.
